## Checklist

- [ ] One topic; no unrelated formatting or renaming churn in this diff
- [ ] Tests added or updated — a regression test for a fix, coverage for new behaviour
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour is user-visible (`docs/`, READMEs)
- [ ] `spec/` updated in this pull request if a public contract changed (API, plugin API, manifest, storage layout, export format)
- [ ] An ADR is included, or none is needed — see the criteria in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Prose is British English, matching CONCEPT.md and the ADRs
- [ ] Commit subjects are imperative and under 72 characters; bodies explain why
- [ ] **No AI attribution anywhere** — no `Co-Authored-By` for a tool, no "Generated with", no assistant signature in commits, comments, files or this description
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the DCO
- [ ] I have read the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and my contribution is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later
